subject: F-41 service 5 GAME
claim: The r806919 Wizard 1.610 Root.wad message definitions identify service 5 as GAME and define its ordered message tags and field types as catalogued here.
how_to_repeat: Read GameMessages.xml from Root.wad in your own r806919 install with `bindecode` --client <install> --text GameMessages.xml.

Read ServiceID and ProtocolType from _ProtocolInfo/RECORD; enumerate each message RECORD and retain each non-metadata field name and its TYPE (or the supported TPYE/TYP spelling, with GlobalID inferred as GID).

Use explicit _MsgOrder or _MsgType where the first message has it; otherwise sort distinct message element tags by byte-ordinal order and number them from 1, collapsing repeated tags only when their fields match.
Run `bindecode --client <install> --sweep` as an archive-decode check; the sweep covers BINd entries, not the XML message definitions.
evidence: `bindecode` --client <install> --text GameMessages.xml read this definition from the local r806919 Root.wad; it declares service id 5, protocol name GAME, and 253 distinct ordered messages with 915 fields.
The service uses tag-ordinal order; the catalog records every message tag/name, resolved order, and field name/type, excluding underscore-prefixed metadata.

`bindecode --client <install> --sweep --threads 8` reported 173088 entries, 134640 BINd files, 134635 decoded, 5 unknown-root-class failures and 0 unreadable entries; those five BINd failures do not validate or contradict this XML catalog.
disproof: A repeat read of GameMessages.xml from another r806919 install that yields a different service id/name, distinct message order, or field name/type under the stated ordering rule.
